display.title: T2: The Redstone Servo
display.subtitle: The part that makes it tick
description: The §bRedstone Servo§r is Thermal's workhorse component - redstone fused
around iron. It drives augments, machine logic, and a dozen Thermal recipes.
Craft a couple of Redstone Servos to complete this beat; you will burn
through them building out the rest of the tier.
§7Servos are the second half of the Thermal component tree, after the frame.
